name: ego_vehicle
description: The primary vehicle from whose dashboard camera the scene is captured

name: double_yellow_lines
description: Continuous double yellow road markings indicating a no-passing zone or road division

name: left_side_ego
description: The left-hand side of the ego vehicle relative to its direction of travel

name: left_turn_lane
description: A dedicated lane for left turns at the intersection

name: road
description: The asphalt street on which the ego vehicle is traveling

name: single_white_line
description: A single white pavement marking appearing on the right side of the ego vehicle

name: right_side_ego
description: The right-hand side of the ego vehicle relative to its direction of travel

name: school_xing_sign
description: Yellow 'SLOW SCHOOL XING' sign painted on the road surface

name: intersection
description: The road junction that the ego vehicle is approaching and entering

name: Sighting Card
description: A player's facedown card kept in Stacks, revealed during an Encounter at Dusk to gain or lose Myth based on Human distribution at the Site, then resolved for its printed effect.

name: Stack
description: A pile of 3 face-down Sighting Cards arranged secretly during setup; the top card is revealed first when its corresponding Hiding Spot is involved in an Encounter.

name: Hiding Spot Token
description: A numbered token placed on a Wilderness Site that links to one of the player's three Stacks; having it at the Encounter Site triggers the reveal of that Stack's top Sighting Card.

name: Encounter
description: The event during the Dusk Phase at the Site with the most Humans and at least one Hiding Spot, where players with a Hiding Spot there reveal their top Sighting Card.

name: Myth
description: The game's scoring currency; players gain or lose Myth according to the revealed Sighting Card's conditions based on Human types present at the Encounter Site.

name: Human Token
description: Tokens representing Hikers, Hunters, and Researchers placed on Wilderness Sites; their distribution determines the Myth outcome when a Sighting Card is revealed.

name: Dusk Phase
description: The third phase of each round where the Encounter occurs and Sighting Cards are revealed.

name: Card Effect
description: The printed ability on each Sighting Card that is resolved after its Myth gain/loss is applied upon reveal.

name: Real Deal
description: A high-risk, high-reward Sighting Card type that can yield large Myth gains or losses depending on Humans at the Site, and grants +7 endgame Myth if never revealed.

name: Hoax
description: A Sighting Card type that typically gains Myth when revealed to Hikers.

name: Decoy
description: A Sighting Card type that typically gains Myth when revealed to Hunters.

name: Silhouette
description: A Sighting Card type that typically gains Myth when revealed to Researchers.

name: Sighting Cards
description: Core scoring cards that players arrange into hidden Stacks; when revealed at an Encounter Site, they grant or cost Myth Points based on Human distribution and trigger a one-time effect.

name: Stacks
description: Three face-down piles of three Sighting Cards each, created during setup and mapped to the player's three Hiding Spot Tokens.

name: Hiding Spot Tokens
description: Player markers placed on Wilderness Sites that link to a specific Stack; having one at the Encounter Site causes the top Sighting of that Stack to be revealed.

name: Encounter Site
description: The Wilderness Site with the most Humans and at least one Hiding Spot where Sighting Cards are revealed each Dusk Phase.

name: Dusk Phase
description: The third phase of each round when Sighting Cards are revealed in player order at the Encounter Site.

name: Human Tokens
description: Hikers, Hunters, and Researchers placed on Sites; their distribution at the Encounter Site determines the Myth gain or loss of a revealed Sighting Card.

name: Myth Points
description: The game's victory points, gained or lost immediately when a Sighting Card is revealed.

name: Real Deal
description: A high-risk/high-reward type of Sighting Card; any Real Deal left unrevealed in a Stack at game end is worth bonus Myth.

name: Hidden Trait
description: A secret objective dealt at setup that influences how a player should order their Sighting Cards in Stacks.

name: End Game Scoring
description: Final scoring step after five rounds where remaining Sighting Cards are flipped and unrevealed Real Deals award bonus Myth.
